enemies.name: Lesser Shade
enemies.description: Lesser Shades once carried messages between the halls of the sanctum. The corruption scattered the words they carried, and now they cannot tell which order is true. One moment they attack, the next they hide.

enemies.name: Bone Crawler
enemies.description: Bone Crawlers were set to tend the sanctum's ossuary and keep the bones of the faithful safe. Fallen, they wear those bones as armour and guard them from everyone. A Bone Crawler stays behind its plates for as long as it can, and strikes only when the shell is thick enough.

enemies.name: Dark Acolyte
enemies.description: The acolytes kept the sanctum's rites. This one still reads the old hymns from its book, but every word now feeds the corruption. It watches you closely, and each ward it raises is stored and poured into its next spell.

enemies.name: Tomb Guardian
enemies.description: The Tomb Guardian swore an oath to keep vigil over the sealed tombs. It still keeps that oath, long after it has forgotten why. It draws every attack towards itself, and when its shield breaks, it answers in kind.

enemies.name: Void Knight
enemies.description: Once a knight of the god's host, sworn to bring wars to an end. The corruption turned that oath inside out: now the fight is all it wants, and it has cast off its armour to have more of it. Wound it badly and the light in its cracks turns red — that is when it is most dangerous.

enemies.name: Boss Knight
enemies.description: The god's last champion stands at the summit of the sanctum. It fights in phases — steel, then walls of stone, then magic that silences your hand — still certain it is doing right. It will not step aside. Breaking it is the only way to set it free.
